summary: New paginate() with three tests that only use an exact multiple of the page size. Invoked with the base ref `main`.

defects.description: Only 20 items with page size 10 are tested, an exact multiple, so a partial last page is never exercised; `Math.ceil` -> `Math.floor`/`Math.round` survives. A test with e.g. 21 items must expect totalPages 3 and a 1-item last page.

Out-of-range pages (0, negative, beyond totalPages) and the empty list (totalPages = 1 via Math.max) are never tested, so the clamping in `Math.min(Math.max(1, page), totalPages)` and `Math.max(1, ...)` survives.
`hasNext` is only ever asserted false; replacing the expression with `false` survives. Page 1 should assert hasNext === true. (The first-page test also checks only the length, not which items.)
